---

## Tutors Codebase Architecture Report

### 1. Overall Project Structure

This is a **single SvelteKit application** (not a monorepo). Version 15.2.0.

**Top-level directories:**
- `D:\code\tutors\src\` -- Main application source (routes, lib, hooks)
- `D:\code\tutors\static\` -- Static assets (PDF.js worker, icons, OpenDyslexic fonts)
- `D:\code\tutors\tests\` -- Test suites
- `D:\code\tutors\test-course\` and `D:\code\tutors\test-course-python\` -- Local test course data
- `D:\code\tutors\guides\` -- Development guides
- `D:\code\tutors\reports\` -- Reports directory
- `D:\code\tutors\.github\` -- CI/CD workflows

**Key source directories under `src/`:**
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\` -- Business logic organized by domain
  - `course/` -- Course data loading, caching, tree traversal
  - `community/` -- Analytics, real-time presence, catalogue
  - `connect/` -- Authentication and user session management
  - `markdown/` -- Markdown-to-HTML processing (Shiki, markdown-it)
  - `themes/` -- Theme management, icons, styles
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\` -- All UI/Svelte components
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\` -- SvelteKit file-based routing

**External Tutors packages (from JSR via npm):**
- `@tutors/tutors-model-lib` (v5.0.0) -- Learning object type definitions, tree utilities, search
- `@tutors/tutors-time-lib` (v5.0.3) -- Time/analytics data loading from Supabase

---

### 2. SvelteKit App Routing Structure

File: `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\`

The app uses **route groups** with parenthesized folder names:

- **`(auth)/`** -- Authentication flows
  - `auth/+page.svelte` -- Sign-in page
  - `auth/[courseid]/+page.svelte` -- Course-specific auth redirect

- **`(course-reader)/`** -- Primary course content (shared layout with timer, analytics, breadcrumbs)
  - `course/[courseid]/` -- Course home page
  - `topic/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Topic view
  - `lab/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Step-by-step lab viewer
  - `talk/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Presentation viewer
  - `video/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Video player
  - `note/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Note/PDF viewer
  - `notebook/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Jupyter notebook viewer
  - `paneltalk/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Panel-based presentations
  - `tutorial/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Tutorial viewer
  - `wall/[type]/[courseid]/` -- Gallery/grid of learning objects
  - `search/[courseid]/` -- Full-text search within a course
  - `time/[courseid]/` -- Student analytics dashboard (calendar heatmaps, lab tables)
  - `llm/[courseid]/` -- LLM documentation export (llms.txt convention)

- **`(home)/`** -- Landing page with course list
  - `+page.svelte` -- Welcome page with course visit cards

- **`(live)/`** -- Real-time presence views
  - `live/+page.svelte` -- Platform-wide live activity
  - `live/[courseid]/+page.svelte` -- Course-specific live view (online now, today, this week, etc.)
  - `catalogue/+page.svelte` -- Course catalogue with visit stats

- **`api/`**
  - `marp/+server.ts` -- Server endpoint for Marp slide rendering

**Route loading pattern:** Each route has `+page.ts` (load function, `ssr = false`) calling `courseService.readCourse(params.courseid, fetch)`, then passing the result to `+page.svelte` via `data`.

---

### 3. Real-Time Functionality

Real-time uses **PartyKit WebSockets** via the `partysocket` npm package.

**Key files:**
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\community\services\presence.svelte.ts` -- Course-specific presence (tracks which students are viewing which learning objects)
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\community\services\live.svelte.ts` -- Platform-wide live activity monitoring

**Architecture:**
- **PartyKit server** configured via `PUBLIC_party_kit_main_room` env var
- Two WebSocket connections per session:
  - `partyKitAll` -- Global room `"tutors-all-course-access"` for platform-wide activity
  - `partyKitCourse` -- Course-specific room using `courseId` as room name
- Events are `LoRecord` JSON objects containing: courseId, loRoute, title, user info (name, avatar, sentiment), learning object type
- Events are sent on every learning object page view via `presenceService.sendLoEvent()`
- Events are also persisted to Supabase `tutors-connect-latest` table for historical "latest activity" views

**UI consuming real-time data:**
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(live)\live\[courseid]\+page.svelte` -- Shows students online now and latest activity by time period (today/week/month/year) using Skeleton UI Tabs
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(live)\live\+page.svelte` -- Global live dashboard

---

### 4. Authentication / User Identity

**Stack:** Auth.js (SvelteKit integration) with GitHub OAuth.

**Key files:**
- `D:\code\tutors\src\hooks.server.ts` -- SvelteKitAuth configuration with GitHub provider. Session strategy is JWT, max age 1 year. Extracts `login` (GitHub username) into session.
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\+layout.server.ts` -- Extracts `session.user` from `locals.auth()` and passes to client
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\connect\services\connect.svelte.ts` -- `tutorsConnectService` singleton managing auth flow, reconnection, share toggle, sentiment, course visits, and analytics timer
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\connect\types.ts` -- `TutorsId` type: `{ name, login, email, image, share, sentiment }`
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\connect\services\localStorageProfile.ts` -- Local storage fallback for unauthenticated users
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\connect\services\supabaseProfile.svelte.ts` -- Supabase-backed profile for authenticated users (course visits stored in `tutors-connect-profiles` table)
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(auth)\auth\SigninWithGithub.svelte` -- Sign-in UI

**Anonymous mode:** When `PUBLIC_ANON_MODE=TRUE`, all auth/analytics/presence features are disabled. User identity is tracked via a UUID in localStorage.

**Course access control:** Courses can have `authLevel > 0` (requiring login) and optional `enrollment.whitelist` (array of GitHub logins).

**Sentiment tracking:** Users can set a mood (`"neutral" | "fine" | "delighted" | "confident" | "overwhelmed" | "confused" | "drained"`) stored in `tutors-connect-users` Supabase table.

---

### 5. UI Component Library

**Primary:** **Skeleton UI v4.15.2** (`@skeletonlabs/skeleton` and `@skeletonlabs/skeleton-svelte`)

**Usage found in:**
- `AppBar` component in `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\navigators\MainNavigator.svelte`
- `Tabs` component in `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(live)\live\[courseid]\+page.svelte`
- Menu/Sidebar components in `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\components\`

**CSS framework:** **Tailwind CSS v4.3** with `@tailwindcss/typography` (prose classes) and `@tailwindcss/forms`.

**Theming:** Custom theme CSS files in `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\themes\styles\` (tutors.css, classic.css, dyslexia.css, easter.css). Themes are applied via `data-theme` HTML attribute. Built-in Skeleton themes (cerberus, terminus, rose) are also imported in `app.css`.

**Icons:** **Iconify** (`@iconify/svelte`) with multiple icon libraries (Fluent, Hero, Easter, Festive) managed by `themeService`. Custom `Icon.svelte` component at `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\components\Icon.svelte`.

---

### 6. Course Content Structure and Loading Pipeline

**Content source:** Course JSON files hosted on CDN (typically `[courseId].netlify.app/tutors.json`).

**Loading pipeline:**
1. Route `+page.ts` calls `courseService.readCourse(courseId, fetch)` (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\course\services\course.svelte.ts`)
2. `courseService.getOrLoadCourse()` determines the course URL via `determineCourseUrl()` (supports Netlify subdomains, full URLs, localhost)
3. Fetches `https://[courseUrl]/tutors.json` -- this is the pre-generated course JSON
4. `decorateCourseTree()` (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\course\services\lo-tree.ts`) processes the raw JSON:
   - Sets `courseId`, `courseUrl`, `route` on every Lo
   - Replaces `{{COURSEURL}}` placeholders in routes, images, videos, PDFs
   - Recursively decorates child Los (breadcrumbs, icons, HTML conversion)
   - Builds `loIndex` (Map of route to Lo) and `topicIndex` (Map of route to Topic)
   - Creates walls, companions, calendar
5. Course is cached in `courseService.courses` Map
6. Global runes `currentCourse` and `currentLo` are updated
7. Labs are loaded on demand: `courseService.readLab()` creates `LiveLab` instances that fetch and convert markdown step files

**Lo type hierarchy** (from `@tutors/tutors-model-lib`):
- `Lo` (base) -- type, id, title, summary, contentMd, route, img, icon, video, authLevel
- `Lab` extends Lo -- contains `los: LabStep[]`, has pdf
- `Talk`, `Tutorial` extend Lo -- have pdf
- `Note`, `PanelNote` extend Lo
- `PanelTalk`, `PanelVideo` extend Lo/Talk
- `Composite` extends Lo -- has `los: Lo[]`, `panels`, `units`, `toc`
- `Topic`, `Unit`, `Side` extend Composite
- `Course` extends Composite -- adds courseId, courseUrl, topicIndex, loIndex, properties, enrollment, calendar, etc.

---

### 7. Existing Quiz, Assessment, or Interactive Features

**There are NO existing quiz or assessment features.** A grep for "quiz", "assessment", "question", "answer", "exam", "test.*score" across the entire `src/` directory returned zero meaningful matches (the only hits were the word "example" in URL patterns in `lo-tree.ts` tests).

**Closest interactive features that exist:**
- **Notebook viewer** (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\Notebook.svelte`) -- Jupyter notebook rendering with:
  - "Exercise" cells (tagged with `exercise` metadata) that provide an editable CodeMirror editor
  - "Solution" cells (tagged with `solution` metadata) with a toggle to show/hide
  - "Run" buttons that reveal pre-computed output (not actual code execution)
- **Lab step navigation** (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\Lab.svelte`) -- keyboard-navigable step-through of markdown content
- **Course search** (`D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(course-reader)\search\[courseid]\+page.svelte`) -- full-text search across labs, steps, notes

These represent the most interactive content types currently. A quiz feature would be a **new learning object type**.

---

### 8. State Management

**Svelte 5 Runes** via a custom `rune<T>()` helper function.

**File:** `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\runes.svelte.ts`

The `rune()` function wraps `$state()` in a getter/setter object:
```typescript
export const rune = <T>(initialValue: T) => {
  let _rune = $state(initialValue);
  return { get value() { return _rune; }, set value(v: T) { _rune = v; } };
};
```

**Global runes:**
- `currentCourse` -- Currently loaded Course
- `currentLo` -- Currently active learning object
- `tutorsId` -- Authenticated user identity (TutorsId)
- `currentLabStepIndex` -- Active lab step
- `courseProtocol` -- http:// or https://
- `hideMainNavigator` -- Toggle for main nav bar
- `adobeLoaded`, `animationDelay` -- UI state

**Service-level state:** Each service module (`courseService`, `presenceService`, `liveService`, `themeService`) is a singleton object exported from its `.svelte.ts` file, using Maps and runes for internal state. For example, `presenceService.studentsOnline` is a `rune<LoRecord[]>([])`.

**No external state library** (no Redux, Zustand, Pinia). The pattern is: singleton service objects + global runes + Svelte 5 `$state`/`$derived`/`$effect` in components.

---

### 10. Real-Time Data Stores and Student Activity Tracking

**Supabase tables** (inferred from code):

| Table | Purpose | Key file |
|-------|---------|----------|
| `learning_records` | Per-student, per-LO interaction tracking (duration, count, type, date) | `supabase-client.ts` |
| `calendar` | Daily activity summaries per student per course (timeactive, pageloads) | `supabase-client.ts` |
| `tutors-connect-users` | Student profiles (github_id, avatar, name, email, sentiment, online_status) | `supabase-client.ts` |
| `tutors-connect-profiles` | Course visit history per user (JSON profile blob) | `supabaseProfile.svelte.ts` |
| `tutors-connect-courses` | Course catalogue with visit counts | `catalogue.ts` |
| `tutors-connect-latest` | Latest Lo snapshot per (course, student) for recent activity views | `supabase-client.ts` |

**Analytics flow:**
1. `tutorsConnectService.learningEvent()` is called on every navigation (from `(course-reader)/+layout.svelte` `$effect`)
2. This calls `analyticsService.learningEvent()` which upserts into `learning_records`
3. A 30-second interval timer (`startTimer()`) calls `analyticsService.updatePageCount()` to increment duration and calendar entries
4. Simultaneously, `presenceService.sendLoEvent()` broadcasts via PartyKit and upserts to `tutors-connect-latest`

**Time analytics dashboard:** `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(course-reader)\time\[courseid]\+page.svelte` uses `TutorsTime.loadStudentTime()` from `@tutors/tutors-time-lib` to render:
- Calendar heatmaps (`HeatMaps.svelte`, `CalendarHeatmap.svelte` using `jheat.js`)
- Lab-by-step tables (`LabByStepTable.svelte`)
- Calendar-by-day tables (`CalendarByDayTable.svelte`)
- Student calendar and lab tables

## Tutors Codebase Architecture Report

### 1. Overall Project Structure

This is a **single SvelteKit application** (not a monorepo). Version 15.2.0.

**Top-level directories:**
- `D:\code\tutors\src\` -- Main application source (routes, lib, hooks)
- `D:\code\tutors\static\` -- Static assets (PDF.js worker, icons, OpenDyslexic fonts)
- `D:\code\tutors\tests\` -- Test suites
- `D:\code\tutors\test-course\` and `D:\code\tutors\test-course-python\` -- Local test course data
- `D:\code\tutors\guides\` -- Development guides
- `D:\code\tutors\reports\` -- Reports directory
- `D:\code\tutors\.github\` -- CI/CD workflows

**Key source directories under `src/`:**
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\` -- Business logic organized by domain
  - `course/` -- Course data loading, caching, tree traversal
  - `community/` -- Analytics, real-time presence, catalogue
  - `connect/` -- Authentication and user session management
  - `markdown/` -- Markdown-to-HTML processing (Shiki, markdown-it)
  - `themes/` -- Theme management, icons, styles
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\` -- All UI/Svelte components
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\` -- SvelteKit file-based routing

**External Tutors packages (from JSR via npm):**
- `@tutors/tutors-model-lib` (v5.0.0) -- Learning object type definitions, tree utilities, search
- `@tutors/tutors-time-lib` (v5.0.3) -- Time/analytics data loading from Supabase

---

### 2. SvelteKit App Routing Structure

File: `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\`

The app uses **route groups** with parenthesized folder names:

- **`(auth)/`** -- Authentication flows
  - `auth/+page.svelte` -- Sign-in page
  - `auth/[courseid]/+page.svelte` -- Course-specific auth redirect

- **`(course-reader)/`** -- Primary course content (shared layout with timer, analytics, breadcrumbs)
  - `course/[courseid]/` -- Course home page
  - `topic/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Topic view
  - `lab/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Step-by-step lab viewer
  - `talk/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Presentation viewer
  - `video/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Video player
  - `note/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Note/PDF viewer
  - `notebook/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Jupyter notebook viewer
  - `paneltalk/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Panel-based presentations
  - `tutorial/[courseid]/[...loid]/` -- Tutorial viewer
  - `wall/[type]/[courseid]/` -- Gallery/grid of learning objects
  - `search/[courseid]/` -- Full-text search within a course
  - `time/[courseid]/` -- Student analytics dashboard (calendar heatmaps, lab tables)
  - `llm/[courseid]/` -- LLM documentation export (llms.txt convention)

- **`(home)/`** -- Landing page with course list
  - `+page.svelte` -- Welcome page with course visit cards

- **`(live)/`** -- Real-time presence views
  - `live/+page.svelte` -- Platform-wide live activity
  - `live/[courseid]/+page.svelte` -- Course-specific live view (online now, today, this week, etc.)
  - `catalogue/+page.svelte` -- Course catalogue with visit stats

- **`api/`**
  - `marp/+server.ts` -- Server endpoint for Marp slide rendering

**Route loading pattern:** Each route has `+page.ts` (load function, `ssr = false`) calling `courseService.readCourse(params.courseid, fetch)`, then passing the result to `+page.svelte` via `data`.

---

### 3. Real-Time Functionality

Real-time uses **PartyKit WebSockets** via the `partysocket` npm package.

**Key files:**
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\community\services\presence.svelte.ts` -- Course-specific presence (tracks which students are viewing which learning objects)
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\community\services\live.svelte.ts` -- Platform-wide live activity monitoring

**Architecture:**
- **PartyKit server** configured via `PUBLIC_party_kit_main_room` env var
- Two WebSocket connections per session:
  - `partyKitAll` -- Global room `"tutors-all-course-access"` for platform-wide activity
  - `partyKitCourse` -- Course-specific room using `courseId` as room name
- Events are `LoRecord` JSON objects containing: courseId, loRoute, title, user info (name, avatar, sentiment), learning object type
- Events are sent on every learning object page view via `presenceService.sendLoEvent()`
- Events are also persisted to Supabase `tutors-connect-latest` table for historical "latest activity" views

**UI consuming real-time data:**
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(live)\live\[courseid]\+page.svelte` -- Shows students online now and latest activity by time period (today/week/month/year) using Skeleton UI Tabs
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(live)\live\+page.svelte` -- Global live dashboard

---

### 4. Authentication / User Identity

**Stack:** Auth.js (SvelteKit integration) with GitHub OAuth.

**Key files:**
- `D:\code\tutors\src\hooks.server.ts` -- SvelteKitAuth configuration with GitHub provider. Session strategy is JWT, max age 1 year. Extracts `login` (GitHub username) into session.
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\+layout.server.ts` -- Extracts `session.user` from `locals.auth()` and passes to client
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\connect\services\connect.svelte.ts` -- `tutorsConnectService` singleton managing auth flow, reconnection, share toggle, sentiment, course visits, and analytics timer
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\connect\types.ts` -- `TutorsId` type: `{ name, login, email, image, share, sentiment }`
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\connect\services\localStorageProfile.ts` -- Local storage fallback for unauthenticated users
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\connect\services\supabaseProfile.svelte.ts` -- Supabase-backed profile for authenticated users (course visits stored in `tutors-connect-profiles` table)
- `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(auth)\auth\SigninWithGithub.svelte` -- Sign-in UI

**Anonymous mode:** When `PUBLIC_ANON_MODE=TRUE`, all auth/analytics/presence features are disabled. User identity is tracked via a UUID in localStorage.

**Course access control:** Courses can have `authLevel > 0` (requiring login) and optional `enrollment.whitelist` (array of GitHub logins).

**Sentiment tracking:** Users can set a mood (`"neutral" | "fine" | "delighted" | "confident" | "overwhelmed" | "confused" | "drained"`) stored in `tutors-connect-users` Supabase table.

---

### 5. UI Component Library

**Primary:** **Skeleton UI v4.15.2** (`@skeletonlabs/skeleton` and `@skeletonlabs/skeleton-svelte`)

**Usage found in:**
- `AppBar` component in `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\navigators\MainNavigator.svelte`
- `Tabs` component in `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(live)\live\[courseid]\+page.svelte`
- Menu/Sidebar components in `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\components\`

**CSS framework:** **Tailwind CSS v4.3** with `@tailwindcss/typography` (prose classes) and `@tailwindcss/forms`.

**Theming:** Custom theme CSS files in `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\themes\styles\` (tutors.css, classic.css, dyslexia.css, easter.css). Themes are applied via `data-theme` HTML attribute. Built-in Skeleton themes (cerberus, terminus, rose) are also imported in `app.css`.

**Icons:** **Iconify** (`@iconify/svelte`) with multiple icon libraries (Fluent, Hero, Easter, Festive) managed by `themeService`. Custom `Icon.svelte` component at `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\components\Icon.svelte`.

---

### 6. Course Content Structure and Loading Pipeline

**Content source:** Course JSON files hosted on CDN (typically `[courseId].netlify.app/tutors.json`).

**Loading pipeline:**
1. Route `+page.ts` calls `courseService.readCourse(courseId, fetch)` (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\course\services\course.svelte.ts`)
2. `courseService.getOrLoadCourse()` determines the course URL via `determineCourseUrl()` (supports Netlify subdomains, full URLs, localhost)
3. Fetches `https://[courseUrl]/tutors.json` -- this is the pre-generated course JSON
4. `decorateCourseTree()` (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\course\services\lo-tree.ts`) processes the raw JSON:
   - Sets `courseId`, `courseUrl`, `route` on every Lo
   - Replaces `{{COURSEURL}}` placeholders in routes, images, videos, PDFs
   - Recursively decorates child Los (breadcrumbs, icons, HTML conversion)
   - Builds `loIndex` (Map of route to Lo) and `topicIndex` (Map of route to Topic)
   - Creates walls, companions, calendar
5. Course is cached in `courseService.courses` Map
6. Global runes `currentCourse` and `currentLo` are updated
7. Labs are loaded on demand: `courseService.readLab()` creates `LiveLab` instances that fetch and convert markdown step files

**Lo type hierarchy** (from `@tutors/tutors-model-lib`):
- `Lo` (base) -- type, id, title, summary, contentMd, route, img, icon, video, authLevel
- `Lab` extends Lo -- contains `los: LabStep[]`, has pdf
- `Talk`, `Tutorial` extend Lo -- have pdf
- `Note`, `PanelNote` extend Lo
- `PanelTalk`, `PanelVideo` extend Lo/Talk
- `Composite` extends Lo -- has `los: Lo[]`, `panels`, `units`, `toc`
- `Topic`, `Unit`, `Side` extend Composite
- `Course` extends Composite -- adds courseId, courseUrl, topicIndex, loIndex, properties, enrollment, calendar, etc.

---

### 7. Existing Quiz, Assessment, or Interactive Features

**There are NO existing quiz or assessment features.** A grep for "quiz", "assessment", "question", "answer", "exam", "test.*score" across the entire `src/` directory returned zero meaningful matches (the only hits were the word "example" in URL patterns in `lo-tree.ts` tests).

**Closest interactive features that exist:**
- **Notebook viewer** (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\Notebook.svelte`) -- Jupyter notebook rendering with:
  - "Exercise" cells (tagged with `exercise` metadata) that provide an editable CodeMirror editor
  - "Solution" cells (tagged with `solution` metadata) with a toggle to show/hide
  - "Run" buttons that reveal pre-computed output (not actual code execution)
- **Lab step navigation** (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\Lab.svelte`) -- keyboard-navigable step-through of markdown content
- **Course search** (`D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(course-reader)\search\[courseid]\+page.svelte`) -- full-text search across labs, steps, notes

These represent the most interactive content types currently. A quiz feature would be a **new learning object type**.

---

### 8. State Management

**Svelte 5 Runes** via a custom `rune<T>()` helper function.

**File:** `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\runes.svelte.ts`

The `rune()` function wraps `$state()` in a getter/setter object:
```typescript
export const rune = <T>(initialValue: T) => {
  let _rune = $state(initialValue);
  return { get value() { return _rune; }, set value(v: T) { _rune = v; } };
};
```

**Global runes:**
- `currentCourse` -- Currently loaded Course
- `currentLo` -- Currently active learning object
- `tutorsId` -- Authenticated user identity (TutorsId)
- `currentLabStepIndex` -- Active lab step
- `courseProtocol` -- http:// or https://
- `hideMainNavigator` -- Toggle for main nav bar
- `adobeLoaded`, `animationDelay` -- UI state

**Service-level state:** Each service module (`courseService`, `presenceService`, `liveService`, `themeService`) is a singleton object exported from its `.svelte.ts` file, using Maps and runes for internal state. For example, `presenceService.studentsOnline` is a `rune<LoRecord[]>([])`.

**No external state library** (no Redux, Zustand, Pinia). The pattern is: singleton service objects + global runes + Svelte 5 `$state`/`$derived`/`$effect` in components.

---

### 9. Key Dependencies (from `D:\code\tutors\package.json`)

**Runtime dependencies:**
- `@tutors/tutors-model-lib` (v5.0.0) -- Lo types, course tree utilities, search
- `@tutors/tutors-time-lib` (v5.0.3) -- Time/analytics data from Supabase
- `codemirror` + `@codemirror/*` -- Code editor for notebook exercises
- `@marp-team/marp-core` -- Marp slide rendering
- `mermaid` -- Diagram rendering in markdown

**Dev/build dependencies of note:**
- `@sveltejs/kit` (2.64+), `svelte` (5.56+), `vite` (8.x), `typescript` (6.x)
- `@skeletonlabs/skeleton` + `@skeletonlabs/skeleton-svelte` (4.15.2) -- UI components
- `tailwindcss` (4.3), `@tailwindcss/typography`, `@tailwindcss/forms`
- `@supabase/supabase-js` (2.108+) -- Database client
- `partysocket` (1.1.19) -- PartyKit WebSocket client
- `@auth/sveltekit` (1.11.2) -- Auth.js SvelteKit integration
- `shiki` (4.2+) -- Syntax highlighting
- `pdfjs-dist` (6.0) -- PDF rendering
- `@iconify/svelte` -- Icon rendering
- `jheat.js` (5.2) -- Heatmap visualization (used in time analytics)
- Testing: `vitest`, `@playwright/test`, `@testing-library/svelte`, `msw`, `@stryker-mutator`

---

### 10. Real-Time Data Stores and Student Activity Tracking

**Supabase tables** (inferred from code):

| Table | Purpose | Key file |
|-------|---------|----------|
| `learning_records` | Per-student, per-LO interaction tracking (duration, count, type, date) | `supabase-client.ts` |
| `calendar` | Daily activity summaries per student per course (timeactive, pageloads) | `supabase-client.ts` |
| `tutors-connect-users` | Student profiles (github_id, avatar, name, email, sentiment, online_status) | `supabase-client.ts` |
| `tutors-connect-profiles` | Course visit history per user (JSON profile blob) | `supabaseProfile.svelte.ts` |
| `tutors-connect-courses` | Course catalogue with visit counts | `catalogue.ts` |
| `tutors-connect-latest` | Latest Lo snapshot per (course, student) for recent activity views | `supabase-client.ts` |

**Analytics flow:**
1. `tutorsConnectService.learningEvent()` is called on every navigation (from `(course-reader)/+layout.svelte` `$effect`)
2. This calls `analyticsService.learningEvent()` which upserts into `learning_records`
3. A 30-second interval timer (`startTimer()`) calls `analyticsService.updatePageCount()` to increment duration and calendar entries
4. Simultaneously, `presenceService.sendLoEvent()` broadcasts via PartyKit and upserts to `tutors-connect-latest`

**Time analytics dashboard:** `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(course-reader)\time\[courseid]\+page.svelte` uses `TutorsTime.loadStudentTime()` from `@tutors/tutors-time-lib` to render:
- Calendar heatmaps (`HeatMaps.svelte`, `CalendarHeatmap.svelte` using `jheat.js`)
- Lab-by-step tables (`LabByStepTable.svelte`)
- Calendar-by-day tables (`CalendarByDayTable.svelte`)
- Student calendar and lab tables

---

### Summary for Quiz Feature Planning

**What exists that you can build on:**
- Supabase infrastructure for data persistence (add quiz results tables)
- PartyKit WebSockets for real-time features (live quiz sessions)
- Auth system with user identity (`tutorsId.login` as student identifier)
- Learning object type system (add a `quiz` Lo type in `tutors-model-lib`)
- Existing route patterns to follow (create `(course-reader)/quiz/[courseid]/[...loid]/`)
- Analytics pipeline to record quiz attempts alongside other learning events
- Skeleton UI + Tailwind for consistent UI
- Notebook's exercise/solution pattern as UX inspiration

**What you would need to create:**
- A new Lo type (`quiz`) in `@tutors/tutors-model-lib` (or handle it at the reader level)
- A new route under `(course-reader)/quiz/`
- Quiz UI components in `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/`
- Supabase table(s) for quiz questions, submissions, and results
- Integration with `courseService` for loading quiz data
- Integration with `analyticsService`/`presenceService` for tracking quiz events
